title: Budget vs actual scorecard
objective: Calculate variance and variance %, flag stores outside tolerance and count the misses.
instructions: B holds each store's budget and C its actual sales, both in K. In D2:D6 calculate the variance (actual minus budget). In E2:E6 calculate the variance % (variance divided by budget, times 100) rounded to 1 decimal place with ROUND. In F2:F6 use ABS to show "Miss" when the variance % is more than the tolerance in I2 away from zero in either direction, otherwise "On track". In I3 use COUNTIF to count the stores flagged Miss.
hints: ABS(E2) gives the size of the gap whichever way it goes. Compare it with $I$2 inside IF.
COUNTIF takes a range and a condition: the flags in F2:F6 and the text "Miss".
